trial.program_source:
def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=0]
    if not pts: return out
    h=max(r for r,c in pts)-min(r for r,c in pts)+1
    w=max(c for r,c in pts)-min(c for r,c in pts)+1
    if w>h:
        out[0]=[3]*len(out[0])
    else:
        for row in out: row[-1]=3
    return out
